review_notes: I read the whole file. Its definitions are key, anchor, b, u, c, present, travel, charge, potential, selected, Observed, q, anchors and a. All of them are specific to the KServer joint experiment and mostly wrap project-internal objects: HeavyKeys.key, heavyAnchor, band, reference, HeavyAnchorDynamics.present and LevelKeys.anchor. None of them is a competing version of a Mathlib, Batteries or core concept. J is only an abbrev for HeavyLabels.Pool Y. The general lemmas (disjoint_variation, band_variation, refresh_all, slot_injective) are theorems, and the rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication. A grep of the KServer directory found duplicated project-internal definitions elsewhere: avg in Ranks.lean and PrefixAllocation.lean, and mass in several files. This file does not introduce them, so they are outside this review. I did not exhaustively check every external dependency, but I found no Mathlib counterpart for any of this file's definitions.
